name: nwm-hydrology-benchmark-Zarr
description:
NOAA National Water Model (NWM) — Hydrology ML Benchmark (Zarr)
	

This benchmark is derived from the NOAA National Water Model (NWM) Retrospective v2.1 Zarr data on AWS Open Data.

Upstream source (public, no auth):
s3://noaa-nwm-retrospective-2-1-zarr-pds/chrtout.zarr (streamflow)
s3://noaa-nwm-retrospective-2-1-zarr-pds/precip.zarr (RAINRATE forcing)


Variables:
streamflow (m³/s): CHRTOUT streamflow at basin outlet reach
precipitation_rate (mm/hr): RAINRATE sampled at the nearest… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/KokosDev/nwm-hydrology-benchmark-Zarr.
evaluation_method: continuous forecasting/regression metrics such as RMSE, MAE and hydrology-specific skill metric Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE)
typical_sota_score: 0.5–0.9 (NSE, highly variable by basin and task)
reputation: Derived from NOAA National Water Model retrospective Zarr data on AWS Open Data; widely respected and used in the hydrology and geoscience ML research communities.
